description: Fear & Greed readings from alternative.me, CoinMarketCap or CFGI: 0-100 value, canonical classification, unix timestamp, ISO dates, source context and (for CFGI) the 10 component scores.

readings.description: Dataset with one record per reading. Reading fields include value, valueClassification, timestamp, date, datetimeUtc, source, indexName, derived trend statistics, and source-native context such as BTC price/volume (CoinMarketCap) or market cap and component scores (CFGI). Bad date input or an unavailable source produces a typed error record.
